title: Python Full Stack Developer(exp:5+yr)
description:
We are looking for an experienced **Python Full Stack Developer with 5\+ years of hands\-on experience** in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in **Python backend development, REST APIs, databases, and modern frontend technologies**.

The candidate will be responsible for developing end\-to\-end applications, collaborating with cross\-functional teams, troubleshooting production issues, and delivering high\-quality, scalable, and secure solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable full\-stack web applications using **Python**.
* Develop robust and secure backend services and **RESTful APIs**.
* Work with Python frameworks such as **Django, Flask, or FastAPI**.
* Develop responsive and user\-friendly frontend applications using **React.js, Angular, or similar technologies**.
* Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and third\-party services.
* Design and optimize database schemas, queries, and data models.
* Work with relational and NoSQL databases such as **PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB**, etc.
* Implement authentication, authorization, role\-based access control, and application security best practices.
* Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and well\-documented code.
* Perform unit testing, integration testing, debugging, and performance optimization.
* Participate in code reviews and follow established development standards.
* Troubleshoot and resolve application and production issues.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers, QA engineers, DevOps engineers, product managers, and other developers.
* Work with **Git\-based version control** and CI/CD processes.
* Contribute to system design, technical documentation, and architectural decisions.
* Ensure applications are scalable, reliable, and optimized for performance.

Required SkillsBackend

* Strong proficiency in **Python**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Django / Flask / FastAPI**.
* Strong understanding of **REST API development and integration**.
* Experience with authentication mechanisms such as **JWT, OAuth, or session\-based authentication**.
* Good understanding of object\-oriented programming, data structures, and design patterns.

Frontend

* Strong hands\-on experience with **React.js, Angular, or similar frontend frameworks**.
* Good knowledge of **JavaScript / TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3**.
* Experience consuming and integrating REST APIs.
* Understanding of responsive web application development.

Database

* Strong experience with **SQL databases**, preferably PostgreSQL or MySQL.
* Experience writing optimized SQL queries.
* Good understanding of database design, indexing, relationships, and transactions.
* Exposure to **MongoDB or other NoSQL databases** is an advantage.

Tools \& DevOps

* Strong experience with **Git/GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket**.
* Understanding of **CI/CD pipelines**.
* Exposure to **Docker and containerization**.
* Basic understanding of cloud platforms such as **AWS, Azure, or GCP** is preferred.
* Familiarity with Linux/Unix environments is a plus.

Good to Have

* Experience with **AWS/Azure/GCP**.
* Knowledge of microservices architecture.
* Experience with **Redis, Celery, RabbitMQ, or Kafka**.
* Understanding of asynchronous programming in Python.
* Experience with automated testing frameworks such as **PyTest or unittest**.
* Knowledge of system design and application scalability.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Educational Qualification

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering**, or a related field.
* Equivalent practical experience may also be considered.

Required Experience

* **5\+ years of professional software development experience**.
* Strong hands\-on experience in **Python Full Stack Development**.
* Proven experience developing and deploying production\-grade web applications.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

Preferred Tech Stack

**Python \| Django / Flask / FastAPI \| React.js / Angular \| JavaScript / TypeScript \| REST APIs \| PostgreSQL / MySQL \| MongoDB \| Git \| Docker \| CI/CD \| AWS / Azure / GCP**

Pay: ₹90,000\.00 \- ₹120,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
